note: Miami County KS publishes no queryable parcel polygon service. Parcels are visible only in the Schneider Beacon viewer (no public ArcGIS REST endpoint); county GIS pages link only to Beacon. ArcGIS Hub/Online search found only roads, addresses, fire districts and survey layers from the county account, no parcels. ORKA statewide services (KS_ORKA_Extras) hold subdivisions and lots, not Miami parcels. Only paid vendor parcel files exist.
